description: The tables the 'Direct Message Owner' role holds Read on, at User (Basic) depth, so that Dataverse accepts the memberless 'Spaarke Direct Message Owners' team as the OWNER of an unfiled Direct 1:1 message and the rows fm task 054a assigns to it. The team lives in the Direct-message business unit: a direct child of the root that holds no users, never the root and never Secure Record. The role is created once in the root (Dataverse copies it into every child unit) and the Direct unit's copy is assigned to the Direct team only. The audience of a Direct-team-owned message is exactly its thread's participants, through per-participant Read shares (uac-r2 task 198); the team grants no one anything because it has no members. Dataverse refuses an owner whose roles lack Read on the table ('Read Privilege Check For Owner failed ... is missing prv<Read> privilege'). This file is the ONE list for the Direct team. scripts/Set-CustomerOwnerTeams.ps1 -DirectMessageBusinessUnitName reads it. Do not copy it anywhere else.

howToExtend: The tables are exactly those fm task 054a assigns to the Direct team. Add a table only when fm names it (TODO-fm above).

'privilegeName' is the Read privilege's name from metadata (EntityDefinitions(LogicalName='x')/Privileges, PrivilegeType eq 'Read'). The casing follows the schema name. The script checks it against metadata and refuses a mismatch.
Then run: scripts/Set-CustomerOwnerTeams.ps1 -EnvironmentUrl <url> -DirectMessageBusinessUnitName <name> (dry run), then -Apply (owner go), then -Verify. The script never creates the business unit.

Never add a depth, an access type or a member here. The role grants Read at User (Basic) depth and nothing else; the team has no members, ever, and holds no other role, and the Direct business unit holds no users.

tables.reason: fm task 054: an unfiled Direct 1:1 message is owned by the Direct team; participants read it through their own Read shares (DirectThreadAccessService).
tables.evidence: No refusal of its own is recorded: the probe is a Dataverse write, made only after the owner's go (the team does not exist yet). The Read privilege name prvReadsprk_Communication is the one config/secure-record-owner-role.json records for sprk_communication; the script checks it against metadata before any write.
